HMG is a purified gonadotropin blend supplied for in-vitro research into combined FSH and LH receptor signaling pathways.

In research settings, HMG is studied for its dual-receptor activity profile, particularly in models evaluating follicular-phase signaling cascades and comparative gonadotropin receptor assays.
